card.line: The Valley of Jezreel is a wide, fertile plain in Israel where armies gathered and where the town of Jezreel stood, the setting for the downfall of Ahab's family.

moments.title: Enemy armies camp here
moments.text: The Midianites, Amalekites, and other eastern peoples crossed the Jordan and camped in the Valley of Jezreel. The Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he rallied Israel to meet them.

moments.title: Elijah runs ahead of Ahab
moments.text: After the heavy rain began, Ahab rode to Jezreel. The hand of the LORD came upon Elijah, and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran ahead of Ahab all the way there.

moments.title: Naboth's vineyard
moments.text: Naboth owned a vineyard in Jezreel next to Ahab's palace. He refused to give up his fathers' inheritance, and Jezebel's plot led to his being stoned to death.

moments.title: Jehu strikes down Joram
moments.text: Jehu drove to Jezreel, where King Joram was recovering from his wounds. Joram met him on Naboth's property, and Jehu shot him, as the LORD had said would happen.

moments.title: Jezebel's end
moments.text: When Jehu arrived in Jezreel, Jezebel looked down from a window. Her servants threw her down, and it happened as the LORD had spoken through Elijah.
